source.title: Comparative efficacy of glucose-lowering medications on body weight and blood pressure in patients with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis

limitations: The selected Drive folder contains the supplementary appendix and PRISMA-NMA checklist but not the main article full text.
The source is a systematic review/network meta-analysis (secondary research); review-level pooled results are tagged as secondary_source/review_level_result.

The appendix contains hundreds of pairwise and network comparison cells. ATOM extraction prioritizes the complete drug-class-versus-placebo league-table results for the three outcomes plus key review methods/quality assertions, rather than creating an atom for every matrix cell.
Primary-study atoms require direct extraction from the cited trial publications.
